name: Hamzah Zainudin
_note: M1 dry-run subject: opposition frontbencher, the hardest harmonization case. Scored period is his closed tenure as Leader of the Opposition (Dec 2022 to Apr 2026). Data on file, below ranking validity (peer set < 3 and most governing-centric dimensions are not applicable to an opposition role), so no composite or rank is published. He remains the elected Member for Larut.

periods.office: Leader of the Opposition, Dewan Rakyat (17th)

metrics.justification: No personal corruption charge or conviction of record against the leader. The graft cases reported in 2024-2025 are against his former political secretary and, separately, his son, not the leader himself. Under the A5 attribution rule an associate's or family member's case is not the leader's status, so it is not recorded against him. Status is therefore 'none-on-record'.

citation.title: Former political secretary to Hamzah Zainudin goes on trial Aug 25 over RM350,000 graft charges
